provider: NIKON IMAGE SPACE and Nikon Imaging Cloud

free_tier.stated: NIKON IMAGE SPACE, with its free tiers and the SnapBridge upload, was terminated on 2026-10-15. Its replacement, the image storage of Nikon Imaging Cloud, is 5 GB

per_object_cap.stated: Not published; Nikon Imaging Cloud storage accepts JPG, RAW, HEIF and TIFF images

retention.stated: The service was terminated on 2026-10-15 09:00 JST and replaced by Nikon Imaging Cloud with 5 GB; stored images are not migrated, a bulk download is open from 2026-10-15 12:00 to 2027-04-15 13:00 JST, and all data is deleted at that time

tooling: no public API. SnapBridge is the only ingest path
chaining: The only unlimited thing is a 2-megapixel downscaled JPEG, which is the ingest-re-encode trap in its purest form: the bytes that come back are not the bytes you sent.

limits.value: 5 GB account total on Nikon Imaging Cloud (the Image Space tiers ended with the service); JPG, RAW, HEIF and TIFF only
the service was terminated on 2026-10-15 and all stored data is deleted on 2027-04-15 13:00 JST

identity_cost.detail: a Nikon ID, free to create; the 5 GB image storage is not tied to a registered product

reliability_note: Terminated on 2026-10-15 09:00 JST. Stored images are not migrated to the replacement and are deleted on 2027-04-15 13:00 JST. The replacement offers 5 GB
